record.scope_note: Borderline as a rule on AI use in one public sector: the State Board of Education requires the trustees of every Florida College System institution to adopt AI policies. Included because rules that a government body sets for a whole sector are in scope; the policies each college adopts for itself are not.

verification.note: Stored in this run, all from official hosts. From flrules.org (the Florida Administrative Code and Register site of the Florida Department of State): the rule page for 6A-14.0719, unchanged since 14 Oct 2026, with the effective date and the notice history (development notice of 27 May 2026, proposed rule of 25 Aug 2026, no notice of change); the final notice 31445186, with the rule file date (30 Sep 2026) and the effective date (20 Oct 2026); the Florida Administrative Register issue of 25 Aug 2026 with the notice of proposed rule, the full text and the hearing date of 16 Sep 2026; and the text of the rule as adopted, a Word file that has no text layer and so cannot be quoted. From fldoe.org: the Department of Education press release of 16 Sep 2026 saying that the State Board adopted the AI rules, including those for Florida College System institutions, that day. The summary follows the proposed text, which the rule page shows was adopted without a notice of change; a plain-text reading of the adopted Word file shows the same provisions.
